title: RouteBundle (route body for dc_route_commit)
description: Route body passed once to dc_route_commit (docs 04 §3.1). Mirrors contracts::route (core-rust). Rust only aligns the vehicle on this route (no road network). Fixed-point contract (provisional, team proposal): each chunk has origin_e7 {lat, lon} (1e-7 deg) and k_lat_q16 / k_lon_q16 = cm per 1e-7 deg in Q16 (u32), computed once by C++ (k_lon uses cos(lat)); dx_cm = round_q16((lon_e7 - origin.lon) * k_lon_q16), dy_cm = round_q16((lat_e7 - origin.lat) * k_lat_q16) with i64 intermediates and round_q16(v) = (v + 2^15) >> 16 (arithmetic shift, exact halves toward +inf). A chunk is valid for a fix inside the bounding box of its points plus a 1 km margin; near a boundary Rust converts with both chunks and takes the smaller lateral distance (tie: smaller along). Distances exist per leg (seg_along_cm) and for the whole route (along_route_start_cm + leg value = along_route_cm). Checks JSON Schema cannot express (chunk continuity, edge coverage, ordering, totals) are done by Rust on load (E_SCHEMA). The root is a RouteBundle; dc_route_commit takes #/$defs/RouteCommitRequest.

RouteCommitRequest.description: dc_route_commit input. expected_route_key = guard: the current route's key from planner_cmds commit{req_id, route_key} (the current route when the search started), or null when no route is committed yet. Must equal the current route (null = none), otherwise E_STALE and nothing is replaced. bundle.route_key is the new route's key with route_revision "0"; Rust assigns the revision (current + 1, first route: 1) and returns the key in the result {route_key, legs, segments, maneuvers}.

route_key.description: Key of this (new) route with route_revision "0" (team decision 2026-11-26): Rust assigns current + 1 (the first route of a session: 1), rewrites this key and every ManeuverId.route_key of the bundle to it, and returns it in the dc_route_commit result. Any other revision is E_SCHEMA. While a route is current, trip_id / trip_revision / graph_version must equal the current route's (E_STALE).

eta_ms.description: Total travel time (ms) = cum_time_ms of the last edge of the last leg.

length_cm.description: Total length (cm) = sum of the legs' length_cm.

leg_index.description: Equal to the position in legs.

along_route_start_cm.description: along_route_cm of the leg's first point (sum of the previous legs' length_cm).

length_cm.description: Leg length (cm) = seg_along_cm of the last point of the last chunk.

chunks.description: Leg shape split into chunks (about 20 km each, 07 §1). Consecutive chunks share their boundary point (same leg_shape_index and seg_along_cm).

edges.description: Edges covering the leg shape without gaps: edges[0].from_pt = 0, edges[i].from_pt = edges[i-1].to_pt, the last to_pt = last shape index.

maneuvers.description: Maneuvers of this leg in route order (04 §2 Maneuver, normalized by C++ per 04 §2.1). id.route_key = bundle route_key (route_revision "0"; rewritten by Rust to the assigned revision), id.leg_index = anchor.leg_index = leg_index.

first_shape_index.description: leg_shape_index of points_cm[0]. The next chunk starts at first_shape_index + len(points_cm) - 1.

k_lat_q16.description: cm per 1e-7 deg of latitude in Q16 (about 72955 = 1.1132 cm). Upper bound 2^20 keeps the i64 products safe.

k_lon_q16.description: cm per 1e-7 deg of longitude in Q16 (k_lat_q16 * cos(lat), computed once by C++).

points_cm.description: [dx_cm, dy_cm] relative to origin_e7 (x east, y north), i32.

seg_along_cm.description: Distance from the leg start to each point (cm, non-decreasing); same length as points_cm.

bearing_cdeg.description: Heading of each segment points_cm[i] -> points_cm[i+1], centidegrees clockwise from north, computed by C++ (Rust has no atan2). Length = len(points_cm) - 1.

from_pt.description: Leg shape index where the edge starts.

to_pt.description: Leg shape index where the edge ends (> from_pt).

cum_time_ms.description: Travel time from the route start to the end of this edge (ms, non-decreasing over the route). Remaining ETA = eta_ms - time at the matched position.

flags.description: Bit set. Provisional (TODO(schema-v1)): 1 tunnel, 2 motorway, 4 toll, 8 ferry.
